paragraphs: Our work at Crestwood School focused on site infrastructure near the district's athletic complex, including a new retaining wall and paved roadway that improve access and stabilize the sloped site.
The finished retaining wall and roadway give the school a durable, low-maintenance solution built to hold up to years of game-day traffic and Pennsylvania winters alike.
